notes: Both attempts returned an identical, contract-matching 404 before any 200 was ever reached: {"success":false,"errors":"Feature not available"}. This is the capability's own documented behavior per its guidance: 'Gated on the same group archive flag as archive/restore: when it is off the call is 404 {success: false, errors: "Feature not available"} — a feature gap, not an empty project.' So this 404 is not a malformed-request problem (path_params were exactly and only what describeCapability required: project_id=379335744, no body, no json_path, no query) and not a permissions problem signature (403 is the documented shape for that) — it is the group-level test-plan-archiving feature flag being off for project 379335744/PR-2005 in preprod. Because the 200 path was never reached, the declared {success, count} shape could not be exercised at all — this is stronger than the count=0-is-still-PASS nuance the task called out: a 0 in a 200 body would count as a fully-formed scalar response, but a 404 feature-gate means the endpoint could not be exercised in its documented working mode in this environment, so this is BLOCKED, not PASS/UNVERIFIED with a zero count. No further attempts were useful: the capability takes no other parameters to vary (path_params.project_id only, no query, no body, no json_path), and the response was deterministic across both calls, so a 3rd identical attempt was skipped as pointless.
